questions.question: What did Naomi want to find for her daughter-in-law Ruth, so that it would go well with her?
When Ruth met Boaz at the threshing floor at midnight, what did she ask him to do?

answers.text: Spread the corner of his garment over her
Walk her home to Naomi at first light
Speak to the elders of the town for her

questions.question: After Ruth told Naomi what Boaz had done, why did Naomi tell Ruth to wait and see how things go?

answers.text: Boaz will not rest until it is settled today
The nearer redeemer is away from town
Boaz needs some time to think it over

questions.question: Before Ruth went home to Naomi, Boaz filled her shawl with six measures of what?
